timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: What's the difference between Azure Policy and Blueprints?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Policy enforces individual rules. Blueprints bundle multiple policies and resources into a repeatable template.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: So Blueprints are like a starter kit for new subscriptions?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Exactly. One Blueprint deploys policies, roles, ARM templates, and resource groups all at once.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: What effects does Azure Policy support?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Deny blocks non-compliant deployments. Audit logs violations. Modify adds or removes properties.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: It checks if a related resource exists and creates it automatically if missing. Very powerful.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: Can it fix resources that are already deployed?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Yes, remediation tasks. They scan existing resources and apply modifications to bring them into compliance.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: Where do I see all my compliance results?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Policy Insights in the Azure portal. Central dashboard showing compliant and non-compliant resources.
